messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P12345 fired — deploy(realtime:v2.7.3) canary in us-west-2: sustained 5xx > 3% and p99 latency >10s for 5+ mins.
alice_nguyen: oncall acked, I'm taking this.
pd-bot: P12345 acknowledged by alice_nguyen.
mike_choi: seeing large request queue on realtime-pod-3, kube restarts + streaming timeouts, errors: `503` / `502` mix.
sre_oncall_1: thanks. Are canary pods crashing or just slow? please paste `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=realtime -o wide`.
alice_nguyen: pods are up but CPU spike + eviction throttles on node gpu-a-12. logs show repeated `kv cache refresh` timeouts.
devops_matt: rollback flag still open in deploy pipeline. I'll try to divert traffic to stable revision and stop rollout: `fluxctl suspend --kind=Kustomization realtime`.
alice_nguyen: running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/realtime --to-revision=12 -n prod` now — will wait for old pods to warm.
mike_choi: confirming embed endpoints return 200 after divert on a few requests, but p99 still high for streaming endpoints.
cs_julia: CS reporting increased errors from a single large tenant (tenant: acme-inc). They're getting timeouts on long responses.
lena_pm: priority check — how many customers affected and is data loss possible?
alice_nguyen: initial telemetry: ~2.3% of requests across top-10 customers saw errors during the window; no evidence of data loss/log truncation. Severity set to SEV2.
sre_oncall_1: creating incident bridge and tagging eng-runtime. Bridge: https://internal.bridge/P12345 (posted).
pd-bot: Bridge created by sre_oncall_1.
devops_matt: rollback progressing — old pods are Pulling image and Ready: 6/6 within 90s.
mike_choi: post-rollback metrics: 5xx rate trending down, p99 latency dropping back toward baseline (from ~12s -> ~1.4s).
alice_nguyen: rolling back autoscaler changes made in canary (reverting HPA target to 60% -> 70%).
sre_oncall_1: thumbs up. Can someone run `kubectl logs -n prod realtime-... | rg "kv cache"` and paste top 5 errors for the postmortem?
alice_nguyen: pasted snippet in bridge: ```ERROR kv_cache.go:212 timeout waiting for refresh after 3 attempts
ERROR kvcache: invalidation loop exceeded backoff```.
mike_choi: mitigation effective, customer-facing errors reduced to normal. I'll coordinate post-incident follow-up and release hold.
alice_nguyen: PD incident P12345 resolved — closing after monitoring 15m with steady metrics. :thumbsup:
pd-bot: Incident P12345 resolved by alice_nguyen.
lena_pm: please add rollback reason & timeline to the incident doc and loop in account execs for acme-inc.
alice_nguyen: will file follow-up and schedule a postmortem tomorrow. Thanks all.
